name: terranova
description: TerraNova — clean, feature-by-feature rebuild of GrahmOS. Offline-first emergency resilience, emergency communications, SafetyMap.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @terranova/core && npm run build -w @terranova/cli && npm run build -w @terranova/relay && npm run build -w @terranova/console
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run gates && npm run build
scripts.packs: node packages/cli/dist/main.js pack fixture apps/console/public/packs/city-center-stadium.zip && node packages/cli/dist/main.js pack fixture apps/console/public/packs/harbor-general-hospital.zip --venue harbor-general
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @terranova/core && npm run build -w @terranova/cli
